scene mayainvdorm1
So of course that unfaithfulness ultimately led me here — to the wrong side of something familiar. Just a step or two away from another instance of impulse disguised as fate.
lines.zh: 所以那份不忠当然最终把我带到了这里——带到某个熟悉之物的错误一侧。离又一次伪装成命运的冲动只差一两步。

lines.en: {size=-1}I don’t like her smile. I don’t like how her flesh is still warm when it should feel like porcelain. I don’t like that ribbon. I don’t like her eyes. How she doesn’t blink as much as she’s meant to.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}我不喜欢她的笑。我不喜欢她的皮肉在应该像瓷器一样冰凉的时候却依然温热。我不喜欢那条发带。我不喜欢她的眼睛。不喜欢她眨眼眨得没有应有那么多。{/size}

lines.en: I love it.
lines.zh: 我爱这一切。

lines.en: And that’s far worse and far heavier than any amount of disdain, understandable or not, could ever be.
lines.zh: 而这远比任何分量的轻蔑——无论那种轻蔑是否情有可原——都要糟得多、也沉重得多。

lines.en: : So, assuming your dreadful niece hasn’t left another package for me to deliver, would you like to come inside and continue our date?
lines.zh: : 那么，假设你这个可怕的侄女没再留包裹让我送，你愿意进来继续我们的约会吗？

lines.en: : Daughter.
lines.zh: : 女儿。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm2
: Fine. I can roleplay.
lines.zh: : 行。我会角色扮演。

lines.en: : No, Maya. I meant that Ami is my {i}daughter{/i} now. I don’t want you-
lines.zh: : 不，Maya。我是说 Ami 现在是我{i}女儿{/i}了。我不想让你——

lines.en: : I know exactly what you meant. That’s why I tried to swiftly move past it with the offer of a charade you can’t possibly refuse.
lines.zh: : 我完全知道你是什么意思。所以我才想赶紧翻篇，抛出一个你绝对无法拒绝的角色扮演提议。

lines.en: : Just, I {i}can{/i} refuse.
lines.zh: : 只是，我拒绝{i}得了{/i}。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm3
: Can you...{i}Daddy?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你确定吗……{i}爸爸{/i}？

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm4
: Don’t just {i}ignore{/i} me, Daddy. I’ve waited all day for you to come home. And I’ve been {i}so{/i} lonely. Maybe we could-
lines.zh: : 别{i}不理{/i}我啊，爸爸。我等了你一整天回家。我{i}好{/i}寂寞。也许我们可以——

lines.en: : Okay, fine. You win. I can’t refuse that. But I can’t refuse {i}you{/i} in general, so...this was unfair from the start.
lines.zh: : 好，行。你赢了。这个我拒绝不了。不过反正我什么也拒绝不了{i}你{/i}，所以……从一开始就不公平。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm5
: You refuse me plenty. It’s actually quite annoying. You never {i}used{/i} to be like that.
lines.zh: : 你拒绝我的次数可多了。其实挺烦人的。你{i}以前{/i}从不这样。

lines.en: : It used to be like, “Hi, Maya. Sex?” And then I’d be like, “Indeed.” Then three minutes later I’d be all sticky and gross and need to take a shower.
lines.zh: : 以前都是这样的："嗨，Maya。做爱吗？"然后我就说："当然。"然后三分钟后我就黏糊糊、脏兮兮的，得去洗个澡。

lines.en: : Three minutes? Really?
lines.zh: : 三分钟？真的？

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm6
: Realistically, it’s probably closer to two. I just decided to include the extra sixty seconds of you hovering above me once you’ve finished to make you feel better about yourself.
lines.zh: : 实事求是地说，大概更接近两分钟。我决定多算上你完事后悬在我身上那额外的六十秒，好让你自我感觉好一点。

lines.en: : How kind of you...
lines.zh: : 你真是太体贴了……

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm1
: Are you coming in or not?
lines.zh: : 你到底进不进来？

lines.en: : Because I may not have a tree for you to fuck me up against, but I {i}do{/i} have all of those costumes I alluded to earlier which I will gladly let you choose from.
lines.zh: : 因为我这儿虽然没有树可以让你把我顶在上面干，但我{i}有{/i}之前提过的那些戏服，我很乐意让你随便挑。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm7
: Or I guess I can just act disinterested since that seems to turn you on better than anything nowadays. You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 要不我就装作没兴趣好了，反正如今似乎那样比什么都更能让你兴奋。你真恶心。

lines.en: : Okay, you win. Hi, Maya. Sex?
lines.zh: : 好，你赢了。嗨，Maya。做爱吗？

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm8
: I suppose I can indulge your perverted desires if it means making you slightly less incorrigible in the near future.
lines.zh: : 我想我可以纵容一下你那点变态的欲望，如果这能让你在不远的将来稍微没那么不可救药的话。

lines.en: : I think you were supposed to just say “indeed.”
lines.zh: : 我觉得你本来该只说"当然"。

lines.en: : And I think {i}you{/i} should be spending more time with girls you wouldn’t get arrested for merely looking at.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得你该多花点时间陪那些你光是看一眼就不会被抓起{i}来{/i}的女孩。

lines.en: scene black
: Alas — my bad luck must continue and I must now spread my legs for what I can only imagine is-
lines.zh: : 唉——我的霉运还得继续，我现在就得为那个我只能想象的——

lines.en: : You don’t need to imagine anything, Maya. You know exactly how big my-
lines.zh: : 你什么都不用想象，Maya。你很清楚我的有多大——

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm9
: Hi, Aki-kun! Long time, no see.
lines.zh: : 嗨，Aki-kun！好久不见。

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : How big your {i}what{/i} is, Dad?
lines.zh: : 你的{i}什么{/i}有多大，爸爸？

lines.en: : Uhh...hi...Ami...
lines.zh: : 呃……嗨……Ami……

lines.en: : I...didn’t really expect you to...be here.
lines.zh: : 我……真没想到你会……在这儿。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm10
: Yeah, well, I was tired of listening to you fuck Niki’s brains out every night. So I figured I’d come spend the night here to give myself a break from all of that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊，我听腻了你每天晚上把 Niki 的脑子操出来的声音。所以我想不如过来住一晚，让自己喘口气。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm11
: Oh, and Maya’s here too. Sorry if that was a little abrasive.
lines.zh: : 哦，Maya 也在啊。如果刚才有点冲，不好意思。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm12
: Why...are you here?
lines.zh: : 你……为什么在这儿？

lines.en: : Hm? Because we share this dorm room, silly.
lines.zh: : 嗯？因为我们共用这间宿舍啊，笨蛋。

lines.en: : Yes. But you {i}specifically{/i} told me earlier that you would not {i}be{/i} here tonight. You know, like how you’re {i}never{/i} here at {i}all{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: : 是。可你{i}明明{/i}之前跟我说过你今晚不会{i}在{/i}这儿。你知道的，就像你现在根本就不怎么在这儿一样。

lines.en: : {size=-1}To be completely fair, Maya, it should have been a dead giveaway that I {i}would{/i} show up when I went out of my way to tell you I wouldn’t. Since that’s been the norm and all.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}说句公道话，Maya，我特意跑来跟你说我不会来，这本身就已经是很明显的暗示了——我{i}肯定{/i}会出现的。毕竟这一直是常态嘛。{/size}

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm13
: Yeah! Maybe if you didn’t {i}also{/i} fucking tell me that the reason I had to do your stupid, box-based chores was because you were busy!
lines.zh: : 是啊！{i}也{/i}许如果你他妈的没跟我说，你让我做那些愚蠢的、跟盒子有关的杂事，是因为你很忙的话！

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm14
: Oh yeah. I did say that, didn’t I? Wow. Maybe I {i}am{/i} the bad guy here after all then?
lines.zh: : 哦对。我确实说过，对吧？哇。那这么看来我{i}才是{/i}这里的坏人了？

lines.en: : You think?!
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？！

lines.en: : Ew — Aki-kun, you’re not planning on fucking that...{i}thing{/i} you dragged in, are you? I taught you better than that.
lines.zh: : 呕——Aki-kun，你该不会打算跟那个你拖进来的……{i}东西{/i}上床吧？我教过你要更好的。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm15
: Oh, right. If you talk to me with Ami around, she might lash out. Good thinking, Aki-kun.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。有 Ami 在的时候你要是跟我说话，她可能会发火。想得挺周到，Aki-kun。

lines.en: : But seriously though, are you really gonna fuck that thing?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，你真要跟那个东西上床吗？

lines.en: : Sorry — were you guys planning on having sex tonight?
lines.zh: : 抱歉——你们俩今晚是打算做爱吗？

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm16
: Oh, yay! She’s just like me!
lines.zh: : 哦，好耶！她跟我一样！

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm17
: If we were, would that be a problem?
lines.zh: : 如果我们是，那会有问题吗？

lines.en: : I figure letting me fuck your dad is the least you can do since you’re going to make me do all {i}sorts{/i} of shit now, Ami. That sounds fair, right?
lines.zh: : 我想，既然你要让我做{i}各种各样{/i}的事，Ami，那让我操你爸爸就是你最起码能做的。听起来挺公平的，对吧？

lines.en: : Oh, yay! You think I’m his daughter again. I could have sworn I heard you call me his niece just a minute ago. But yeah! Go for it.
lines.zh: : 哦，好耶！你又把我当他女儿了。我明明一分钟前还听到你叫我侄女来着。不过没关系！上吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, I didn’t think-
lines.zh: : 是啊，我没想到——

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm18
: Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: : Yeah. I won’t get in the way. I’ll probably touch myself, though. But only if you guys are okay with that.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我不会碍事的。不过我大概会自己摸。当然前提是你们俩不介意。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm19
: I mean...I won’t say I’m {i}against{/i} it...
lines.zh: : 我是说……我也不能说我{i}反对{/i}……

lines.en: : On second thought...I should probably just...go.
lines.zh: : 再想想……我大概还是……走吧。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm20
: But...things were going so well! And you said it yourself that you would try and spend more time with me! Don’t let Ami’s fucking...creepiness get in the way of that!
lines.zh: : 可是……明明进展得那么顺利！而且你自己说了你会试着多陪我的！别让 Ami 那该死的……变态劲儿搅了这件事！

lines.en: : Hey! My creepiness has been mostly unobtrusive lately! I take offense to that!
lines.zh: : 喂！我最近的变态行径已经相当不碍事了！我对此表示抗议！

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm21
: Unobtrusive?! That’s what you call it?! Getting in the way of my personal life just to fuck with me?! Because that sounds pretty {i}obtrusive{/i} to me, Ami!
lines.zh: : 不碍事？！你管那叫不碍事？！为了耍我而妨碍我的私生活？！因为在我看来那相当{i}碍事{/i}，Ami！

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm22
: Again — why does it have to be so nasty?
lines.zh: : 再说一遍——为什么非得这么恶毒？

lines.en: : I’m not getting in the way of anything, though. I just said you guys can go at it and I won’t interfere. I’ll just masturbate.
lines.zh: : 可我什么也没碍着啊。我刚说了你们随便来，我不干涉。我就自己解决一下。

lines.en: : Which is probably what I was going to do tonight anyway since I could smell that my dad was in the hall at some point and it turned me on.
lines.zh: : 反正我今晚大概本来也要这么干，因为我闻到过我爸爸有那么一瞬间在走廊里，那让我兴奋了。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm23
: I’ll be more than happy to join in if you’ll let me, though! I’ve just never touched a girl before, so forgive me if I do anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 不过要是你们肯让我加入，我求之不得！我只是从来没碰过女孩子，所以万一我做得不对，请多包涵。

lines.en: : Sensei-
lines.zh: : Sensei——

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm24
: Rain check, Maya. I’m just...not in the mood for this anymore.
lines.zh: : 改天吧，Maya。我只是……没这个心情了。

lines.en: : Wait! I’ll come with you! I don’t-
lines.zh: : 等等！我跟你走！我不——

lines.en: : Just...rain check. Okay?
lines.zh: : 就……改天吧。好吗？

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}alone again. Being dead is so depressing sometimes.
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}又是一个人。死了有时候真让人沮丧。

lines.en: : Aww, man. I was really looking forward to watching you guys.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。我本来还挺期待看你们的。

lines.en: : I can only imagine how intense the sex is if the sheer desire for it can give you strength even when the world around you is tearing into pieces.
lines.zh: : 我能想象，如果对性的纯粹渴望能在你周围的世界被撕成碎片时还给你力量，那这场性得有多激烈。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm25
: I’M FUCKING TIRED OF THIS, AMI! JUST TELL ME WHAT YOU WANT FROM ME! STOP TREATING ME LIKE YOUR FUCKING PUPPET!
lines.zh: : 我他妈受够你了，AMI！干脆告诉我你到底想从我这儿得到什么！别再把我当你他妈的提线木偶！

lines.en: : You’re not a puppet, you’re a doll. Dolls are much cuter.
lines.zh: : 你不是木偶，你是娃娃。娃娃可爱多了。

lines.en: : JUST FUCKING LEAVE ME ALONE! I WANT TO LIVE MY LIFE! I WANT TO BE WITH SENSEI! AND I FINALLY HAD ANOTHER CHANCE TONIGHT AND YOU-
lines.zh: : 你他妈离我远点！我想过我自己的生活！我想跟 Sensei 在一起！我今晚好不容易又有了机会，而你——

lines.en: : Enabled it?
lines.zh: : 成全了它？

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm26
: ...What?
: Well...think about it. If I don’t tell you to dispose of that box, Sensei’s never rocked by his emotional connection to it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你想想。要是我不叫你去处理那个盒子，Sensei 就不会被自己和它的情感联系动摇。

lines.en: : Then the two of you {i}don’t{/i} use the rest of the night to start repairing the broken bridge that is your relationship and go eat takoyaki and stuff.
lines.zh: : 那你们俩也就{i}不会{/i}用剩下的时间去修补你们关系里那座断桥，去吃章鱼烧什么的了。

lines.en: : How do you know about the takoyaki?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道章鱼烧的事？

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm27
: Oh, that’s easy. Sensei isn’t good with technology, so I turned the “find my phone” feature on when I was helping him update his one night and then linked it to {i}my{/i} phone.
lines.zh: : 哦，这个简单。Sensei 不擅长电子产品，所以有天晚上我帮他更新的时候开了"查找{i}我的{/i}手机"，然后关联到了我的手机上。

lines.en: : Now I can see where he is at all times and don’t have to worry anymore!
lines.zh: : 这样我随时都能看到他在哪儿，再也不用担心了！

lines.en: : Smart, right? Anyway, how was dinner?
lines.zh: : 聪明吧？话说回来，晚饭怎么样？

lines.en: : You’re...keeping track of where he is?
lines.zh: : 你……在追踪他的位置？

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm28
: I feel like that’s actually one of the {i}less{/i} crazy things I’ve done. Just wait until you find out what I’ve put in his food.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这其实算是我干过的{i}不那么{/i}疯的事之一。等你发现我在他吃的里面放了什么再说吧。

lines.en: : So is {i}he{/i} your doll too then?! Or is {i}he{/i} a puppet?! And what about everyone else?! Who do you want control of next?!
lines.zh: : 那{i}他{/i}也是你的娃娃了？！还是木偶？！其他人呢？！下一个你想控制谁？！

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm29
: Ayane would be nice. She keeps surprising me. Which is pretty weird given how long I’ve been doing this.
lines.zh: : Ayane 不错。她总能给我惊喜。考虑到我干这行这么久了，这还挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : Here’s a new idea! Why don’t you just leave all of us alone?! I won’t let you torment me into keeping your fucking...reality-breaking secret anymore!
lines.zh: : 我有个新主意！你为什么不干脆离我们所有人远点？！我不会再让你折磨我、逼我替你保守那个该死的……打破现实的秘密了！

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm30
: I can tell based on how loud you’re being right now. I implore you to reconsider, though. At least if you want to keep thinking you’re actually {i}alive{/i} or whatever.
lines.zh: : 从你现在嗓门多大我就看得出来。不过我劝你重新考虑一下。至少在你还想继续以为自己真的{i}活着{/i}什么的之前。

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} alive, though! I have feelings! I’m in love! I have needs and wants and connections and you’re trampling all over them by hanging your fucking...powers over my head!
lines.zh: : 可我{i}是{/i}活着的啊！我有感情！我在恋爱！我有需求、有想要的东西、有牵绊，而你把那些你他妈的……能力悬在我头顶，把它们全踩在脚下！

lines.en: : I don’t {i}have{/i} powers. How many times do I have to tell you this?
lines.zh: : 我没{i}有{/i}能力。这句话我要说多少遍？

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm31
: Well, until someone {i}else{/i} figures out how to pull me through different layers of reality or...timelines or...whatever that was, I’m going to keep assuming you do.
lines.zh: : 嗯，在{i}别人{/i}想出办法把我拽过不同层的现实、或者……时间线、或者……不管那是什么之前，我都会继续假设你有。

lines.en: : But I’m not going to let the fear of that threaten me anymore. And I’m not going to keep doing your bidding just because I’m {i}afraid{/i} of you.
lines.zh: : 但我不会再让这份恐惧威胁我了。我也不会再因为{i}怕{/i}你而继续听你使唤。

lines.en: : Is it just me or is this a bit of an overreaction to just being in the room while you want to fuck my dad?
lines.zh: : 是我多心了，还是说，只是在你想操我爸爸的时候我在房间里，你就反应这么大？

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm32
: It’s more than that and you know it...
lines.zh: : 事情比那严重多了，你心里清楚……

lines.en: : You’re supposed to be my best friend. We’re supposed to be in this {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你本该是我最好的朋友。我们本该{i}一起扛{/i}的。

lines.en: : But instead, you keep treating me like a pet you’ve locked in a cage. One you only take out when you want to trick yourself into thinking you can ever {i}care{/i} for anything.
lines.zh: : 可你却一直把我当宠物关在笼子里。只在你想骗自己、以为自己还能{i}在乎{/i}什么东西的时候，才把我放出来。

lines.en: : When, in all actuality, you’re just neglectful. You don’t actually {i}care{/i} about the things you look after. You care about feeling like you’re doing something {i}good.{/i} But you’re not.
lines.zh: : 而实际上，你只是疏于照料。你并不真的{i}在乎{/i}你照看的东西。你在乎的只是"自己在做{i}好事{/i}"这种感觉。可你没在做好事。

lines.en: : You hurt everyone by just fucking existing. You are {i}nothing{/i} like the Ami I know. Because the Ami I know wouldn’t ever hurt me on purpose.
lines.zh: : 你光是存在着就在伤害所有人。你跟我认识的那个 Ami {i}一点也不{/i}像。因为我认识的那个 Ami 绝不会故意伤害我。

lines.en: : And {i}you{/i} do it just for fun.
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}这么做只是为了好玩。

lines.en: : Feel better?
lines.zh: : 感觉好点了吗？

lines.en: : Not really. No.
lines.zh: : 不太。没有。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm33
: Then why don’t you tell me what I can do to make up for how apparently horrible I am to you? Want me to go get the shackles again?
lines.zh: : 那不如你告诉我，我该怎么弥补我对你显然这么恶劣这件事？要我再去把镣铐拿来吗？

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} can’t do anything. But {i}I{/i} can.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}什么也做不了。但{i}我{/i}可以。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm34
: Oh? And what are {i}you{/i} going to do then?
lines.zh: : 哦？那{i}你{/i}打算做什么？

lines.en: : Ever since Halloween...I’ve been keeping your secret because I’ve been afraid of what you’ll do to me if I {i}don’t.{/i} But that’s not going to get me anywhere.
lines.zh: : 从万圣节之后……我一直替你保守秘密，因为我怕{i}不这么做{/i}你会对我怎么样。可那样我哪儿也去不了。

lines.en: : You’re going to tell Sensei then? That I’m a super-secret time traveling villain and not just a normal girl?
lines.zh: : 那你要去告诉 Sensei 了？说我是一个超级秘密的时间旅行反派，而不是一个普通的女孩？

lines.en: : You gonna leave in the part where I made you cum your brains out too? Or does that one get to {i}stay{/i} secret since it makes you look like a filthy whore?
lines.zh: : 你会连我让你爽到脑子都射出来那部分也一起说吗？还是说那段可以{i}保密{/i}，因为它会让你看起来像个下贱的婊子？

lines.en: : I’ll tell him everything...that part too.
lines.zh: : 我会把一切都告诉他……那部分也说。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm35
: Right. But, just out of curiosity, what exactly do you think this is going to accomplish?
lines.zh: : 行吧。不过我只是好奇，你觉得这到底能达到什么目的？

lines.en: : Do you expect me to just {i}play nice{/i} once I’m dragged into this mess with you guys?  That I’ll stop being clingy and needy? What’s the end game here?
lines.zh: : 你指望我被拖进你们这摊烂事之后就会{i}乖乖听话{/i}吗？指望我不再黏人、不再索求无度？你的最终目的是什么？

lines.en: : I don’t expect any of that...but I expect he’ll stop giving you everything you want just because your mom died.
lines.zh: : 这些我都不指望……但我指望他不会再因为你妈妈死了就把你想要的什么都给你。

lines.en: : Sensei doesn’t give me everything I want because my mom died. He gives me everything I want because he loves me.
lines.zh: : Sensei 给我想要的，不是因为我妈妈死了。是因为他爱我。

lines.en: : And if you tell him I know more than he {i}thinks{/i} I know, do you know what’ll {i}really{/i} happen, Maya?
lines.zh: : 而如果你告诉他，我知道的远比他{i}以为{/i}的多，你知道{i}真正{/i}会发生什么吗，Maya？

lines.en: : He’ll leave every single one of you. Just like he’d have done for the {i}last{/i} girl who lived inside of that skin. He’ll leave you and he’ll be with me. Just me. For the rest of time.
lines.zh: : 他会离开你们每一个人。就像他会为住在那层皮囊里的{i}上一个{/i}女孩所做的那样。他会离开你，然后跟我在一起。只有我。直到时间的尽头。

lines.en: : Don’t play games with me, Ami. If that were true, you’d have fucking told him yourself. You wouldn’t turn down a world where it’s just you and him and you know it.
lines.zh: : 别跟我玩游戏，Ami。要是真那样，你他妈早就自己告诉他了。你不会拒绝一个只有你和他的世界，你自己心里清楚。

lines.en: : You’re right. That would be my perfect world. And it’s exactly what I want. But you’re making me sound worse than I am again.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。那会是我的完美世界。那正是我想要的。可你又在把我形容得比我本人更坏了。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm36
: If Sensei finds out I’ve known what’s been going on this whole time, do you have any idea how much he’ll suffer?
lines.zh: : 如果 Sensei 发现我从头到尾都知道发生了什么，你知道他会痛苦到什么程度吗？

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how {i}terrible{/i} he’ll feel knowing I’ve had to look after myself this whole time while he refuses to come to grips with who he really is to me?
lines.zh: : 你知道，当他知道这一直以来我都得自己照顾自己、而他却拒绝认清他对我来说到底是什么人的时候，他会觉得自己有多{i}糟糕{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Do you {i}really{/i} think that what the two of {i}you{/i} share is stronger than that? Or do you think that maybe, deep down, what he wants is more than just {i}sex?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}以为{i}你们{/i}俩之间的东西比那更牢固吗？还是说，也许在他内心深处，他想要的不只是{i}性{/i}？

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm37
: He wants to be happy. He wants a {i}family.{/i} He wants a normal life in a normal world where he doesn’t have to deal with {i}mistakes{/i} like you.
lines.zh: : 他想要幸福。他想要一个{i}家{/i}。他想要一个正常世界里的正常生活，一个不必应付你这样的{i}错误{/i}的生活。

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} is why I haven’t told him. Because, unlike you, I {i}don’t{/i} want to hurt him. And I {i}won’t{/i} make him suffer just so things will be easier for me.
lines.zh: : {i}所以{/i}我没有告诉他。因为跟你不同，我{i}不想{/i}伤害他。我{i}不会{/i}为了让自己好过就让他受苦。

lines.en: : At least...not on a long-term basis.
lines.zh: : 至少……不会长期如此。

lines.en: : I’m not a bad person, Maya. I just do a lot of bad things.
lines.zh: : 我不是坏人，Maya。我只是做了很多坏事。

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm38
: Which, of course, means that I have no problem deleting you if you’re going to put his wellbeing in jeopardy like you say you are.
lines.zh: : 这当然也意味着，如果你真像你说的那样要危及他的幸福，我会毫不犹豫地把你删掉。

lines.en: : D...Deleting?...
: Words like “kill” are too heavy and dramatic to be wasted on those who have never been alive to begin with.
lines.zh: : 像"杀"这种词太沉重、太戏剧化了，不值得浪费在那些从未活过的人身上。

lines.en: : And while I can’t reset you myself, I can sure find a way to make you {i}wish{/i} I could.
lines.zh: : 虽然我没法自己重置你，但我一定能想出办法让你{i}希望{/i}我能。

lines.en: : Now, if you’re done with your little temper tantrum, do you want to watch a movie together or something?
lines.zh: : 那么，要是你这场小小的脾气发完了，要不要一起看个电影什么的？

lines.en: : A...movie?...
: But we...but I...
lines.zh: : 可我们……可我……

lines.en: scene mayainvdorm39
: You let your emotions get in the way of what needs to be done.
lines.zh: : 你让你的情绪妨碍了该做的事。

lines.en: : You can’t let that happen here.
lines.zh: : 在这里，你不能让这种事发生。

lines.en: : I can teach you how to properly exist in this place, but not if you question me.
lines.zh: : 我可以教你如何正确地存在于这个地方，但前提是你不质疑我。

lines.en: : So just...do as you say? No questions asked?...
lines.zh: : 所以就……照你说的做？一句也不问？……

lines.en: : I’m supposed to just...agree to that? And let you keep trampling all over the things {i}I{/i} want? The things that make {i}me{/i} happy?
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}就该……答应这个？然后让你继续践踏{i}我{/i}想要的东西？让我快乐的东西？

lines.en: : It’s easier than you make it sound.
lines.zh: : 比你听起来容易。

lines.en: scene black
: Just want fewer things.
lines.zh: : 只要想要的东西少一点。
